title: Pullman's stable gains its open belvedere, iron cresting and belt course
items: The stable at 1729 Prairie now has open balusters on its belvedere, iron cresting with corner spires round its roof deck, and a stone belt course under its upper windows, as the 1894 plate and Taylor's photographs show them.
The corner bay's cap leans back onto the corner instead of rising to a point.
The stable is now checked against its three pictures in its own right.
